title: Common definitions (contracts v1)
description: Shared building blocks. Not a payload on its own.

schema_version.description: Contract version; every payload carries it.

telemetry_label.description: What a sensor reading may be: simulated sensor, real measurement or public benchmark.

stream_source.description: Where a stream comes from; always shown.

scalar.description: A displayable value. JSON has no NaN or infinity.

quality.description: Data-quality score of one reading (Master Spec 6.2). The score is computed by a fixed, versioned formula, so it is CALCULATED and names that formula.

template_id.description: Id of a fixed, reviewed, versioned formula or explanation template (Master Spec 10.3).

evidence_label_with_value.description: Labels of a value that exists. An input that is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE makes the result INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE too, so it is not an input.

unit.description: A unit written as one ASCII token (no spaces, no letters outside A-Z, a-z): m, m3, L/s, kWh, EGP/m3. Currencies are written EGP only (see money_consistency).

sensor_key.description: A key in a map the operator sees, naming a sensor or a metric: upper-case letters, digits and underscore only, and none of the reserved words (truth, fault, hidden, probability, confidence, percent, ground, inject). A grammar plus a word list, not proof: code checks the key against the sensors of the run.

detector_key.description: A detector id used as a map key: lower-case letters, digits and underscore only, none of the reserved words.

model_version.description: Version of a detector or model, like d2_v1.

money_consistency.description: Rules for an object with unit, label and value (an evidence record or one of its inputs). A unit that looks like a currency must be spelled exactly EGP or EGP/<m3|kWh|MWh|kW|h|day|month|year>. Money, whether an amount or a price, is never simulator, model, sensor or geometry output (pitfall P-14): it is CALCULATED, an ASSUMPTION, OBSERVED or BENCHMARK. A money value is a JSON number, never formatted text. The currency recogniser is a list of common codes and words: a currency it does not list is caught by the evidence kernel in code.
